messages: IMPORTANT The Solemnity 'The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist' coincides with the Solemnity 'Most Sacred Heart of Jesus' in the year 2022. We should ask the Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments what to do about this!

IMPORTANT Seeing that the Solemnity 'The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist' coincides with the Solemnity 'Most Sacred Heart of Jesus' in the year 2022, it has been anticipated by one day as per Decree of the Dicastery for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments.
'Christmas' falls on a Sunday in the year 2022, therefore the Feast 'Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph' is celebrated on December 30th rather than on the Sunday after Christmas.
'12th Sunday of Ordinary Time' is superseded by the celebration with precedence over solemnities 'Corpus Christi' in the year 2022.
